subject: BlueNova security preflight: Q&A meeting and evidence runbook
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@bluenova-therapeutics.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Security preflight + evidence access for SIG/CAIQ

Hi David,

Thanks again for taking this on. We are preparing a SIG/CAIQ review for our third-party security committee next month and want to run a short preflight with Redwood to align on deliverables and timelines. Our primary asks for the preflight call are: 1) confirm artifact list (SOC 2 mapping, key rotation docs, logging samples), 2) agree on access mechanism for log samples (SFTP or temporary bucket), and 3) quick Q&A on data residency and retention defaults.

Can we schedule 30–45 minutes next week? Our preferred windows: Tuesday 11/30 10–12 PT or Wednesday 12/1 14–16 PT. Please confirm and share a short agenda and any prep artifacts.

Also attaching our internal prep questionnaire (BlueNova_SIG_Prep_Questions.pdf) so you can see what the committee will expect.

Aisha
Aisha Kapoor
Head of InfoSec, BlueNova Therapeutics

---
Attachment: BlueNova_SIG_Prep_Questions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@bluenova-therapeutics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T11:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security preflight + evidence access for SIG/CAIQ

Aisha —

Appreciate the note and the prep doc. We can run 30 minutes and get you the starter artifact bundle ahead of time. Tuesday 11/30 10:30–11:00 PT works for our team; if you prefer Wednesday we can do 14:00–14:45 PT as an alternative.

Pre-call deliverables we will drop in advance: 1) Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx (SOC2-to-SIG mapping + list of available artifacts), 2) SFTP access instructions for log samples, 3) a short evidence runbook (how we package and redact samples). If you have any specific control IDs you want prioritized, send them over and we'll map owners.

Marissa (security) will lead the artifact review on our side; Soojin (compliance) will handle evidence packaging and retention questions.

Draft agenda for the call:
- 5m introductions and scope
- 10m artifact overview (what we can provide + formats)
- 10m access & redaction approach (SFTP/bucket, sample windows)
- 5–10m Q&A and next steps/action owners

Attaching the Redwood packet now.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Director, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bluenova-therapeutics.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@bluenova-therapeutics.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Security preflight + evidence access for SIG/CAIQ

David —

Thanks, 11/30 10:30 PT is good for us. Short note on two items the committee wanted covered up front so we can prioritize on the call: key rotation cadence for KMS-managed keys (esp. customer-managed KMS cases) and concrete examples of log retention windows and the export process for GCP/AWS. Also need a contact for the SFTP drops — will we be sending the files to a Redwood-managed endpoint or will BlueNova pull?

If you could also include SFTP instructions in the packet (preferred) that would speed things up. We'll plan to share a short list of five high-priority control IDs before the call.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Senior Security Engineer, BlueNova Therapeutics

Attachment: (none)
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@bluenova-therapeutics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bluenova-therapeutics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: 11/30 10:30 PT — agenda + SFTP and runbook links

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Confirmed for Tue 11/30 10:30–11:00 PT (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent from Calendar — please accept. Quick logistics:

- SFTP: we'll provide a Redwood-managed SFTP drop for the session. Instructions attached (SFTP-access-instructions.pdf) — we'll also create a temporary account for BlueNova and share credentials during the call via chat. If BlueNova prefers to push to a customer-managed bucket, we can provide a signed URL workflow instead.
- KMS/key rotation: Marissa will cover both our managed-key defaults and the customer-managed KMS flows (including rotation cadence and audit evidence locations).
- Log retention/export: Soojin will show typical retention windows and an example export for GCP logs (we maintain AWS CloudTrail/CloudWatch examples as well).

Attaching a short evidence-runbook and the SFTP instructions. Please drop the five priority control IDs Tom mentioned into the shared Drive link prior to the call (I'll paste the link into the calendar invite).

Action owners before the call:
- BlueNova: paste prioritized control IDs into Drive (Tom)
- Redwood: confirm SFTP account creation and upload Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx + evidence-runbook (David / Marissa)
- Redwood: prepare sample log excerpts (1–2 files, redacted) to be available in the SFTP drop during the call (Soojin)

Look forward to the discussion.

Cheers,
David

Aisha / Tom —

Thanks for the time on 11/30. Quick notes and agreed next steps from Redwood:

Meeting summary (high level):
- Walked through available artifacts (SOC2 mappings, IAM role docs, rotation audit snippets).
- Confirmed Redwood-managed SFTP drop approach and temporary credentials for BlueNova to fetch redacted logs.
- Clarified customer-managed KMS behavior; documented rotation cadence and where rotation artifacts live for audits.

Artifacts we dropped into the SFTP drop and shared Drive:
- SOC2_control-to-SIG_map.csv
- redwood-kms-rotation-summary.pdf
- redwood-log-sample-20261030.json (redacted)
- Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx

Agreed next steps / owners:

- Redwood (Marissa): provide KMS rotation audit extract and a short note on HSM/KMS provider (due 12/4).
- Redwood (Soojin): prepare full artifact manifest for the SIG submission and share a zip to Drive by 12/6.
- Joint: schedule a follow-up if the committee requests additional artifacts (TBD).

If anything above looks off, flag and we'll correct.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager — Redwood Inference
